apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ACME.IAC.RESOURCE.RANDOM.PASSWORD.LONG_ENOUGH
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: A generated password is at least 16 characters long
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: random
        resource_types: [random_password]
  assert:
    path: resource.after.length
    greater_than_or_equal: 16

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.CLOUDTRAIL.RECORDS_ALL_REGIONS
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: CloudTrail trail the change defines records all regions
  description: >-
    A CloudTrail trail the plan defines meets this assertion when it is a multi-region trail. It says nothing about
    trails the change does not define, or whether an account has a trail at all.
  remediation: Set is_multi_region_trail to true on the trail.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  evidence:
    stages: [plan]
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_cloudtrail]
  # Iltero does not check this itself. A scanner such as Checkov does, and the
  # scanner check mapping ILT.SCANNER_CHECKS.STARTER lists which scanner checks to use.
  assert: null

    A CloudTrail trail the plan defines meets this assertion when log file integrity validation is turned on for it.

  evidence:
    stages: [plan]
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_config_configuration_recorder_status]
  # Iltero does not check this itself. A scanner such as Checkov does, and the
  # scanner check mapping ILT.SCANNER_CHECKS.STARTER lists which scanner checks to use.
  assert: null

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.EC2.NO_SSH_OR_RDP_OPEN_TO_THE_INTERNET
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Security group allows no SSH or RDP access from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0
  description: >-
    A security group (including the default security group), security group rule or VPC security group ingress rule
    the plan defines meets this assertion when no ingress it allows from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 uses all protocols or
    covers port 22 or port 3389. Other ways of naming every address, such as a prefix list, are not checked.
  remediation: Limit the source of ingress to ports 22 and 3389 to the address ranges that need it.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types:
          - aws_default_security_group
          - aws_security_group
          - aws_security_group_rule
          - aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule
  assert:
    not:
      any:
        # A security group's own ingress blocks.
        - all:
            - path: resource.type
              in: [aws_default_security_group, aws_security_group]
            - exists:
                in: resource.after.ingress
                where:
                  all:
                    - any:
                        - path: item.cidr_blocks
                          contains: 0.0.0.0/0
                        - path: item.ipv6_cidr_blocks
                          contains: ::/0
                    - any:
                        - path: item.protocol
                          in: ["-1", all, ALL]
                        - all:
                            - path: item.from_port
                              less_than_or_equal: 22
                            - path: item.to_port
                              greater_than_or_equal: 22
                        - all:
                            - path: item.from_port
                              less_than_or_equal: 3389
                            - path: item.to_port
                              greater_than_or_equal: 3389
        # A separate ingress rule of a security group.
        - all:
            - path: resource.type
              equal: aws_security_group_rule
            - path: resource.after.type
              equal: ingress
            - any:
                - path: resource.after.cidr_blocks
                  contains: 0.0.0.0/0
                - path: resource.after.ipv6_cidr_blocks
                  contains: ::/0
            - any:
                - path: resource.after.protocol
                  in: ["-1", all, ALL]
                - all:
                    - path: resource.after.from_port
                      less_than_or_equal: 22
                    - path: resource.after.to_port
                      greater_than_or_equal: 22
                - all:
                    - path: resource.after.from_port
                      less_than_or_equal: 3389
                    - path: resource.after.to_port
                      greater_than_or_equal: 3389
        # A VPC security group ingress rule, which names one address range.
        - all:
            - path: resource.type
              equal: aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule
            - any:
                - path: resource.after.cidr_ipv4
                  equal: 0.0.0.0/0
                - path: resource.after.cidr_ipv6
                  equal: ::/0
            - any:
                - path: resource.after.ip_protocol
                  in: ["-1", all, ALL]
                - all:
                    - path: resource.after.from_port
                      less_than_or_equal: 22
                    - path: resource.after.to_port
                      greater_than_or_equal: 22
                - all:
                    - path: resource.after.from_port
                      less_than_or_equal: 3389
                    - path: resource.after.to_port
                      greater_than_or_equal: 3389

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.IAM.NO_POLICY_ALLOWS_ALL_ACTIONS_ON_ALL_RESOURCES
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: IAM policy does not allow every action on every resource
  description: >-
    An aws_iam_policy, aws_iam_role_policy, aws_iam_user_policy or aws_iam_group_policy the plan defines meets this
    assertion when none of its statements allows Action "*" on Resource "*".
  remediation: Replace the wildcard statement with the actions and resources the principal needs.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  evidence:
    stages: [plan]
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_iam_group_policy, aws_iam_policy, aws_iam_role_policy, aws_iam_user_policy]
  # Iltero does not check this itself. A scanner such as Checkov does, and the
  # scanner check mapping ILT.SCANNER_CHECKS.STARTER lists which scanner checks to use.
  assert: null

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.RDS.BACKUP_RETENTION
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: RDS backups retained for at least seven days
  remediation: Set backup_retention_period to 7 or more.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_db_instance]
  assert:
    path: resource.after.backup_retention_period
    greater_than_or_equal: 7

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.RDS.NOT_PUBLIC
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: RDS instance not publicly accessible
  remediation: Set publicly_accessible to false.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_db_instance]
  assert:
    path: resource.after.publicly_accessible
    equal: false

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.RDS.PRODUCTION_BASELINE
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Production RDS instances are encrypted, private, backed up and not on a burstable class
  remediation: Set storage_encrypted to true, publicly_accessible to false and backup_retention_period to 7 or more, and use an instance class other than db.t3.micro or db.t3.small.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_db_instance]
  when:
    path: organization_scope.environment.production
    equal: true
  assert:
    all:
      - path: resource.after.storage_encrypted
        equal: true
      - path: resource.after.publicly_accessible
        equal: false
      - path: resource.after.backup_retention_period
        greater_than_or_equal: 7
      - path: resource.after.instance_class
        not_in: [db.t3.micro, db.t3.small]

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.RDS.STORAGE_ENCRYPTED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: RDS storage encryption enabled
  remediation: Set storage_encrypted to true.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_db_instance]
  assert:
    path: resource.after.storage_encrypted
    equal: true

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.S3.ENCRYPTED_WITH_KMS_KEY
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: S3 bucket default encryption is aws:kms
  description: >-
    An S3 bucket meets this assertion when its default server-side encryption algorithm is aws:kms, set in an
    aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration for it or on the bucket itself. When the plan has no such
    configuration, the bucket's algorithm is known only after the deployment: the check is unknown at plan, and if it
    is checked again after the deployment, a bucket left on the Amazon S3 managed keys every bucket gets by default
    fails.
  remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration for the bucket that uses aws:kms with a KMS key.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_s3_bucket]
  assert:
    any:
      # An encryption configuration resource for the bucket decides when there is one.
      - exists:
          in: resource.related
          where:
            all:
              - path: item.relation
                equal: configures
              - path: item.type
                equal: aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration
              - exists:
                  in: item.resource.after.rule
                  where:
                    exists:
                      in: item.apply_server_side_encryption_by_default
                      where:
                        path: item.sse_algorithm
                        equal: aws:kms
      # Otherwise the bucket's own encryption setting decides.
      - all:
          - not:
              exists:
                in: resource.related
                where:
                  all:
                    - path: item.relation
                      equal: configures
                    - path: item.type
                      equal: aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration
          - exists:
              in: resource.after.server_side_encryption_configuration
              where:
                exists:
                  in: item.rule
                  where:
                    exists:
                      in: item.apply_server_side_encryption_by_default
                      where:
                        path: item.sse_algorithm
                        equal: aws:kms

apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.S3.PUBLIC_ACCESS_BLOCKED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: S3 bucket blocks all public access
  remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for the bucket that sets all four settings to true.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_s3_bucket]
  assert:
    exists:
      in: resource.related
      where:
        all:
          - path: item.relation
            equal: configures
          - path: item.type
            equal: aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block
          - path: item.resource.after.block_public_acls
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.ignore_public_acls
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.block_public_policy
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.restrict_public_buckets
            equal: true
